freeze_timing: Before C39 quality or C13 confirmation outcomes.
eligible_pair: Both fixed C42R1 recipes must pass the original C42 development/source/mode gates and source/artifact checks first.
protocol: Freeze both complete production sources and both paired predictions, then consume C13 labels together at most once. No recipe, threshold, cohort or model may be chosen using its outcomes.
source: Existing immutable C13 CASMI2022 FT/HCD120:60positive+60negative; one acquisition per query. This is source stress confirmation, not a target timsTOF population proxy.
prediction_inputs: Existing audited original complete P01 C13 predictions and query-only inputs; no true-answer insertion or candidate filtering.
negative_control: Report frozen P14 on the same complete120 with correct all-query zeros; never choose a cohort to make its sign favorable.
qualification_tier: Exploratory fixed pair, not statistical promotion or a public-gain claim. C39 exclusions apply new fitting heads; C13 near-chemistry and public pretraining exposure remain disclosed.

operational_amendment_before_outcomes.reason: Implement the user-authorized continuous goal with an explicit source-bound --release-approved-pair coordinator instead of repeated agent polling.
operational_amendment_before_outcomes.conditions: Only after full C39 collection, independent ranking and exact quality audits pass for BOTH pre-frozen heads, and BOTH real production audits pass. Consume the same paired C13 predictions once through explicit --consume. Stop on any failed gate. At most two entries, first actual score before second.
